sources.title: The Stacks Project, Complements of affine opens
sources.locator: Section31.17: complement of a nonempty affine open in a normal separated variety is pure codimension1. A Hartogs proof is included.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Purity of branch locus
sources.locator: Lemma58.21.4: quasi-finite normal-to-regular morphisms unramified at all height-one generalizations are etale.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Abhyankar's lemma for regular divisor
sources.locator: Lemma58.31.5; iterating parameter-root base changes and purity gives the normal-crossing local Kummer description.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Henselian local rings
sources.locator: Lemma10.153.3(8),(13): etale points have unique sections over a strictly henselian base, and quasi-finite algebras split into a finite part and a part missing the closed fiber.

scope: The primary local/purity inputs are attributed; the image bounds, complete finite subgroup marks, arithmetic normalizer argument and cubic omission controls are proved in the note.
